sumInsured: As per Policy Schedule (not provided in extract)

great.name: Room Rent
great.quote: Eligibility of Room Category of the insured person is 'no sub-limit', which means that there is no separate restriction on Room/Boarding and nursing expenses in case of Hospitalization.
great.explanation: You can choose any room type during hospitalization without any limit on room rent, so your room rent expenses won't reduce your claim amount.

great.name: Restore Benefit
great.quote: automatically make the re-instatement of up to the base Sum Insured once in a policy year... Recharge amount can be utilized for same illness as well as different Illnesses.
great.explanation: The policy restores your base sum insured once per year, which you can use even for the same illness, giving you extra coverage after your limit is used up.

great.name: Built-in SI Buffer
great.quote: the Company shall automatically provide an additional Sum Insured equal to the Sum Insured... (i) ...utilized only after the Sum Insured has been completely exhausted;
great.reference: Clause 3.2.10 – Optional Cover 10 Additional Sum Insured for Accidental Hospitalization
great.explanation: If you opt for this cover, you get extra sum insured for accidents that activates only after your main sum insured is fully used, enhancing your financial protection.

great.name: Modern Treatments
great.quote: The Company will indemnify... for treatment taken through following advance technology methods: ... Robotic surgeries ... Immunotherapy- Monoclonal Antibody ... Stem cell therapy: Hematopoietic stem cells...
great.explanation: Advanced treatments like robotic surgery and immunotherapy are covered without sub-limits, so you won't face restrictions for these modern procedures.

good.name: PED Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing Disease (PED)... shall be excluded until the expiry of 36 months of continuous coverage
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are excluded for 36 months, which is a common waiting period in the market before coverage starts.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed Conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage
good.explanation: Certain listed illnesses and procedures have a 24-month waiting period, which is standard in most policies.

good.name: Initial Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident
good.explanation: Illnesses are not covered for the first 30 days except accidents, which is a typical initial waiting period.

good.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: Under Pre-hospitalization Medical Expenses, for a period of 30 days immediately prior to the Insured Person's date of admission
good.explanation: Medical expenses up to 30 days before hospitalization are covered, helping you with costs leading to your admission.

good.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: Under Post-hospitalization Medical Expenses, for a period of 60 days immediately after the Insured Person's date of discharge
good.explanation: Medical expenses up to 60 days after discharge are covered, assisting with recovery costs after your hospital stay.

bad.name: Consumables
bad.quote: Any item or condition or treatment specified in List of Non-Medical Items (Annexure – II to Policy Terms & Conditions).
bad.reference: Clause 4.2(a)(1) + Annexure II (List of Expenses Generally Excluded)
bad.explanation: Items like gloves and masks are excluded and must be paid out-of-pocket, increasing your expenses during hospitalization.

bad.name: No Claims Bonus
bad.quote: In the event of a Claim occurring during any Policy Year, the accrued No Claims Bonus will be reduced at same rate at which it is accrued at the commencement of next Policy Year;
bad.explanation: Your no-claims bonus reduces after a claim, limiting your ability to build higher sum insured over time.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: The Co-payment proportion (if applicable) as specified in the Policy Schedule shall be borne by the Policyholder / Insured Person on each Claim
bad.reference: General Conditions Applicable to all the Benefits – Point 3
bad.explanation: The policy mentions co-payment may apply but does not specify the percentage, so check your policy schedule to know if and how much co-pay you must pay.

unclear.name: Disease Sub-limits
unclear.quote: If any sub-limits on Room Rent/Category for Medical Expenses are applicable as specified in the Policy Schedule... For diseases or conditions or procedure that have a specified sub-limit then all related expenses shall be covered up to the sub-limit specified
unclear.explanation: The policy allows disease or procedure sub-limits if listed in your schedule, but it is unclear if any apply to your coverage.
